content.comment_body: Hello everyone, I have a question about data logging on [company_name] [product_name] [version_no]. I was trying to log data and noticed that after removing the memory card from the [product_name] base module while it was operating, some logged data was missing. I have attached my program and data log file for reference. Any assistance would be appreciated. Thank you.
You should only insert or remove the memory card when the device is powered off. Additionally, output values are only recorded if those outputs are used within the program.

Hello, I have another question regarding data logging in [product_name] [version_no]. I connected a 0-10V input to the analog terminals I1-I2 & I7-I8. However, when uploading the data log file, I noticed that digital input logs sometimes showed 1 instead of 0, creating inconsistent data. I haven't changed the digital inputs, only the analog ones. I'm unsure why these inconsistencies appear. Please see the attached files for details and share your feedback. Thank you.

Hello, I'm not sure if you're aware, but the terminals I1, I2, I7, and I8 can function as either digital or analog inputs, but not both simultaneously. For instance, if I2 is configured as analog input (AI4), you can't use it as a digital input at the same time in your program. The attached file explains this. AI4 reading 8.64V means that, according to the manual, a digital input registers a signal at voltages above 8.5V—so that's why your data log shows a 1 for I2.
Thank you for your response. Your explanation was very useful. I appreciate the help.
A new question posted by [user_name] has been moved to a separate discussion titled 'No data log is found.' If anyone knows how to resolve this, please share your advice. Best regards, [user_name]

Just to clarify for newcomers: it is not necessary to power off the device; you only need to stop it (enter STOP mode) as per section 9.2 regarding memory card handling. If you remove a micro SD card containing a program with copy protection, note that [product_name] can only run the program stored on the card if it remains inserted during runtime. Removing the card during RUN mode may lead to improper system states.

analysis.insight_summary: Users experienced problems with data logging on [product_name] [version_no], specifically data loss when removing the memory card while the module is running, and inconsistencies in digital input logging when analog inputs are used. These issues reveal that users may not be aware of the device's dual-function inputs, and highlight the need for clearer documentation and improved usability regarding correct system operation and expected behaviors.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect dependable, complete data logging, a clear distinction between analog and digital input behaviors, and straightforward operation that doesn't risk data loss from common actions such as removing the memory card.
